passes.title: Tight double-tap landing
passes.desc: Double tap space in flight: brake, drop straight in, absorb crouch, stand. No run-out.

takes.name: Brake 2 + 5-tick drop
takes.facts: 0.8 blocks of carry · 0.30 s (your note: 0.3 carry)

takes.name: Instant brake, 3-tick drop
takes.facts: 0 blocks of carry · 0.20 s · deeper knee absorb

passes.title: Ring arm leads the flight
passes.desc: A course of turns, a climb and a dive in the fast glide (body laid flat, so the arm reaches out past the head). The ring arm points where you're going; the body follows 0.08 s behind.

takes.name: Pure lead
takes.facts: arm on the movement direction, body 1.6 ticks behind

takes.name: Lead + anticipation
takes.facts: arm overshoots by 25% of the turn rate

takes.name: Lead + bank
takes.facts: plus up to 35° of bank into turns

passes.title: Double-jump take-off
passes.desc: Second jump while airborne. Standing: puff to 3.2 blocks and hover. Running: a fast flat dart to 5 blocks.

takes.name: Snap to hover
takes.facts: 3.2 blocks in 3 ticks, ease-out, small shake

takes.name: Fast spring
takes.facts: settles at 3.2, never above (your note: maybe settle at 2.2)

takes.name: Dart, arm along the side
takes.facts: free arm flush with the body

takes.name: Dart, arm forward and out
takes.facts: free arm further forward and splayed
